svg.title: Everything you come across, in one memory
svg.desc: Articles, YouTube videos, podcasts, social videos, PDFs, screenshots, imports from Pocket and Readwise, voice memos, browser quotes and notes flow into one private memory as numbered passages. A question about John F. Kennedy’s Moon speech is answered from its transcript, and the citation opens the passage at 8:44.
